The measured notebook

The notebook gathers small observations into a clear record that can be read at several screen sizes without losing its comfortable spacing.

Each observation belongs to the same centred column. The column grows in steps while its text keeps a steady inset from either edge.

Compare each visit

Look for a small change in the garden, note its context, and compare it with the previous entry before drawing a conclusion from what you see.
